topic: A person finds out their surprise party has been cancelled
text: The note lay on the wooden table, its edges curling up as if whispering a secret to the air. The words were simple, almost too plain, stating the party was no longer to happen, as if such a gathering had never been planned, as if the anticipation hadn’t woven itself into the fabric of my day. Yet, in this quiet unfolding, I found myself wandering through the rooms of my home, each space now a gallery of possibilities, the air thick with uncharted stories. The house, it seemed, was now a vast estate of whispers and unspoken invitations, each corner a promise of something more, something yet to be discovered.
